findings.summary: executeBatch redundantly executes verifyBuildPasses and verifyCodeChange sequentially for every fixed comment in the post-push loop via verifyComment, after having already evaluated them atomically for the batch.
findings.suggested_fix: Modify verifyComment to accept a flag (e.g. skipExpensiveVerifications) and pass it from executeBatch to bypass these checks, as they were already successfully performed before push.

findings.summary: The pre-push verifyCodeChange call in executeBatch omits the commentId property, causing the verifier agent invocation to be incorrectly tagged with pr_review_comment_id: 0.
findings.suggested_fix: Add commentId?: number to VerifyCodeChangeFn in verify-code-change.ts, and pass commentId: comment.commentId to the verifyCodeChange invocation mapping fixedResults in executeBatch.
